description: This script manages firmware upgrades for Ubiquiti network devices, specifically handling kernel flags, partitioning, and volume cleanup for ERX models. It interacts with device-specific storage partitions and performs kernel boot flag updates.

methods.name: ubnt_update_kernel_flag
methods.description: Sets or verifies the kernel boot index flag at a specific memory offset in the device's factory partition.

methods.name: platform_upgrade_ubnt_erx
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process, including partition cleanup, kernel flag update, and calling the upgrade utility.
